rules.title: San Diego Residential Tenant Protection Ordinance
rules.requirement: Landlords must have at-fault or no-fault just cause to terminate a covered tenancy, state the cause in the notice, and give written notice and relocation assistance for no-fault terminations. They must also give tenants a notice of the ordinance and follow buyout disclosure rules.
rules.key_value: Relocation assistance of 2 months' rent (3 months for seniors 62+ or disabled tenants) for no-fault terminations
rules.penalty: A failure to comply with the right-of-offer rule voids the termination notice (except for withdrawal from the rental market). Buyout agreements that do not strictly comply are void.
rules.citation: San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 7
rules.status_basis: Page states the Ordinance goes into effect June 24, 2023 and is indefinite unless amended.

exempt_if.text: Housing that has been issued a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years, unless the dwelling is a mobilehome.
Residential rental unit alienable separate from title to any other dwelling unit

exempt_if.name: landlord_not_REIT_corporation_or_LLC_with_corporate_member_and_exemption_notice_given
exempt_if.text: Landlord is not a REIT, corporation, or LLC with a corporate member, and tenants were given written notice of the exemption
Two separate dwelling units within a single structure, neither an ADU or JADU

exempt_if.name: owner_occupied
exempt_if.text: Owner occupies one unit as principal residence at the beginning of the tenancy and continues in occupancy
Single-family owner-occupied residence where the owner rents no more than two units or bedrooms

exempt_if.name: transient_hotel
exempt_if.text: Tenant of a transient and tourist hotel, or occupancy of 30 consecutive days or less

exempt_if.name: affordable_housing
exempt_if.text: Housing restricted by deed or regulatory agreement as affordable housing, or subject to an affordable housing subsidy agreement (does not apply to Section 8 voucher tenants)

exempt_if.name: institutional_housing
exempt_if.text: Nonprofit hospital, religious facility, extended care or licensed residential care facility for the elderly, nonprofit transitional housing, or school-owned dormitories

exempt_if.name: shared_facilities_with_owner
exempt_if.text: Tenant shares bathroom or kitchen with the owner, who maintains their principal residence there

exempt_if.name: mobilehome_MRL
exempt_if.text: Mobilehomes subject to the Mobilehome Residency Law

coverage.summary: Applies to tenancies of more than 30 days in residential rental property in San Diego, including rented dwellings in mobilehome parks.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exempts transient lodging, affordable and subsidized housing, institutional housing, certain owner-occupied homes and duplexes, separately alienable units with non-corporate landlords, and housing with a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years.

rules.quoted_span: The purpose of the Ordinance is to require Just Cause for termination of residential tenancies consistent with California Civil Code section 1946.2, to limit the reasons for termination of a residential tenancy, to require greater tenant relocation assistance in specified circumstances and to provide additional tenant protections.
